settings.label: Accent
settings.info: Used for italic words in headings.

settings.label: Labels
settings.info: Used for small uppercase labels, tags and meta text.

settings.label: Show back-to-top button
settings.info: Appears after scrolling, with a ring that fills as the page scrolls.

settings.label: Motion preset
settings.info: Sets every animation at once. Kinetic: long eased reveals, looping type and stretching headings. Editorial: short, quiet reveals and no loops. Still: no movement, hovers change color only. Visitors who prefer reduced motion always get Still, and shoppers can pause motion.

settings.label: Smooth scrolling
settings.info: Adds momentum-based smooth scrolling powered by Lenis. Automatically disabled when the visitor has enabled "Reduce motion" in their operating system.

settings.label: Animate page changes
settings.info: Pages cross-fade and product photos move into the product page. Browsers without support change pages as usual.

settings.label: Stretch headings while scrolling
settings.info: Only with the Kinetic motion preset.

settings.label: Show a "View" cursor over photos
settings.info: For mouse users only. Buttons and the product gallery keep their usual cursor.

settings.label: Issue label
settings.info: Shown in the footer, on the password page and on the 404 page. Leave empty to hide it.

settings.label: Photo treatment
settings.info: Gives mixed photography one look. Color returns on hover. Product pages and the cart always show true color.

settings.label: Favicon image
settings.info: Shown at 32 x 32px. Use a square .png or .svg image.

settings.label: Social share image
settings.info: Fallback image used when a customer shares a page that has no image of its own (home page, generic search). Recommended size: 1200 x 630px.

settings.label: Popular searches
settings.info: Separate with commas. Shown in the search window and on the search page before a shopper types, and when a search finds nothing.

settings.label: Card style
settings.info: Contact sheet frames every photo like a film contact print, with a frame number.

settings.label: Show quick view
settings.info: Products with options open in a quick view window from product cards. Products without options keep quick add.

settings.label: Drop date metafield
settings.info: Optional. The product metafield that holds a drop date, written as namespace.key (for example custom.drop_date). Products with a future date show a countdown and can't be bought until then. Use a date or date and time metafield.

settings.label: Add-to-cart behavior
settings.info: Choose how customers see their cart after adding a product. "Cart page" navigates to /cart. "Cart drawer" slides a panel in from the right without leaving the page.

settings.label: Free shipping threshold
settings.info: Order total in your store currency. Shows a meter in the cart page and drawer. Leave at 0 to hide. Only shown to customers paying in your store currency.

settings.label: Gift wrap product
settings.info: Shown as a checkbox in the cart page and drawer that adds this product.
